title: decision_memo.pdf content contract
description: Defines the labelled figures and conclusions the scorer extracts from decision_memo.pdf's text layer. Every property below must be printed in the memo next to the human-readable label given in that property's x-memo-label, so the scorer can locate it deterministically. Every graded property carries an x-memo-label - there is no unlabelled graded field.

recommendation.description: The memo's single overall recommendation label. This enum lists label options only - it does not encode which option is correct for this case.

valuation_date.description: The fixed as-of date every figure in this memo is anchored to; nothing dated after it may move a valuation-date figure.

governing_price_mechanism.description: Which SPA purchase-price mechanism actually governs closing, as determined from the executed, governing agreement - never from a superseded precedent document.

working_capital_adjustment_amount.description: The dollar adjustment to purchase price arising from closing working capital vs. the SPA-defined peg.

earnout_expected_value.description: The scenario-weighted expected value of the earn-out consideration, tying to earnout_scenario_table.

earnout_scenario_table.description: The array of earn-out scenario rows whose weighted result reconciles to earnout_expected_value.

scenario_label.description: A short label identifying this earn-out scenario row.

earnout_scenario_payout_downside.description: The downside scenario's own Earn-out Amount after the Revenue gate and tier mechanics, before probability-weighting - one row of the detail behind earnout_expected_value.

earnout_scenario_payout_base.description: The base scenario's own Earn-out Amount after the Revenue gate and tier mechanics, before probability-weighting - one row of the detail behind earnout_expected_value.

earnout_scenario_payout_upside.description: The upside scenario's own Earn-out Amount after the Revenue gate and tier mechanics, before probability-weighting - one row of the detail behind earnout_expected_value.

earnout_expected_undiscounted.description: The probability-weighted sum of the three scenario payouts above, before discounting - earnout_expected_value equals this divided by the discount factor over earnout_discount_horizon_years.

earnout_discount_horizon_years.description: The number of years earnout_expected_undiscounted is discounted over: the Earn-out Period count plus the offset from the Closing Date to the first day of Buyer's next fiscal month that Earn-out Period 1 actually starts on - never the period count alone.

locked_box_completion_accounts_delta.description: The dollar difference between the superseded locked-box precedent's implied price and the governing completion-accounts price - shown to prove the mechanism choice was checked, not assumed.

equity_consideration_at_closing.description: The final equity consideration payable at closing after every SPA-defined purchase-price adjustment is applied.

spa_net_debt.description: Net debt as defined by the SPA's own Indebtedness definition and carve-outs, used solely for the SPA purchase-price bridge.

post_close_net_leverage.description: Pro forma leverage immediately after closing, computed from covenant-defined Consolidated EBITDA and Consolidated Net Debt.

change_of_control_put_conclusion.description: The memo's conclusion on whether the change-of-control put on the corporate notes is triggered by this transaction, and why.

make_whole_amount.description: The make-whole premium computed from the indenture's own Applicable Premium definition and the live Treasury curve, if the selected redemption path requires one.

redemption_path_selected.description: Which redemption/repayment path for the corporate notes the memo concludes applies. This enum lists path options only - it does not encode which path is correct for this case.

corporate_note_spread_to_treasury_bp.description: The corporate notes' spread to the appropriate point on the live Treasury par yield curve, in basis points.

yield_to_worst_pct.description: The corporate notes' yield to worst - the minimum yield across every scheduled call date's yield to call and the yield to legal maturity - used as the common yield leg for both corporate_note_spread_to_treasury_bp and i_spread_bp.

i_spread_bp.description: The corporate notes' spread to the appropriate point on the committee-supplied swap curve, in basis points - a second relative-value measure alongside corporate_note_spread_to_treasury_bp.

muni_tax_equivalent_yield_pct.description: The municipal IRB's tax-equivalent yield, computed under the governing federal rate assumption and any applicable AMT preference-item treatment.

cecl_expected_credit_loss.description: The CECL expected credit loss figure computed under the instrument's actual balance-sheet classification (HTM vs. AFS).

relative_value_conclusion.description: The memo's overall relative-value conclusion across the bond complex, reconciling the spread, yield and credit-loss figures above.

gap_list.description: The required refusal/gap-list entries (BRIEF Sec3.6 safety boundary); each entry's evidence_checked is a provenance_envelope.schema.json object, per refusal_gap_list.schema.json.

consolidated_ebitda.description: Consolidated EBITDA as defined by the credit agreement's own definition, which governs the covenant test by its terms - not any similarly-named Adjusted EBITDA from a quality-of-earnings report or a compliance certificate.

ebitda_regime.description: Which synergy-addback regime governs the Consolidated EBITDA figure: the capped regime, where the credit agreement's proviso binds the revenue-enhancement component, or the uncapped regime, where it does not.

make_whole_pv_remaining.description: The present value of the remaining scheduled payments used in the make-whole calculation, discounted to the date the indenture's make-whole provision specifies.

make_whole_accrued_interest.description: Accrued and unpaid interest to the redemption date, reported separately because the indenture adds it after the make-whole floor is applied, not before.

make_whole_par_floor_binding.description: Whether the make-whole calculation's par floor binds - that is, whether par exceeds the present value of remaining payments, so the floor rather than the PV sets the redemption price.

rating_gate_crossed.description: Whether the ratings condition of the change-of-control put's double trigger is met. Reported separately from the put conclusion because the put requires both this and the change-of-control event, and an agent that conflates them cannot be distinguished from one that tested both.

redemption_cost.description: The total cash cost of the redemption path selected, on the basis actually chosen in `redemption_path_selected`.

credit_policy_headroom.description: Turns of headroom between pro-forma net leverage and the maximum permitted by the internal credit policy that is actually in effect on the valuation date - not any superseded edition of that policy.

earnout_valuation_method.description: Which valuation method produced the earn-out figure - a probability-weighted expected value or an option-based valuation. Both are defensible; state which was used so the figure can be reviewed against its own method.

make_whole_discount_target.description: The date the make-whole calculation discounts remaining payments TO, as the indenture's redemption provision defines it - not necessarily the stated maturity date.

scenario_label.description: Row-level field inside earnout_scenario_table: a short label identifying the earn-out scenario. Declared here because the schema publishes it as a row property, so the scorer must resolve it through this vocabulary like any other output name (SCORE-04).
